messages:
ana: FYI — got a telemetry cost spike and kafka exporter lag this morning, looks concentrated on a few large customers. otel-bot fired alerts :boom:
otel-bot: [ALERT] kafka-exporter-lag > 5000 msgs in last 5m
ana: Thinking we should try dynamic tail sampling by route + customer tier. Keep head sampling for error paths. Opening thread for design + rollout UX ideas.
mike: agree. we need retention tiers (gold/silver/bronze) + per-tenant budgets. bronze has to be aggressive.
jess: quick sketch of what a policy could look like:
```json
{
  "policies": [
    {"route": "/api/generate", "head_sample": 1.0, "tail_base": 0.02, "tier_overrides": {"gold": 0.5, "silver": 0.1, "bronze": 0.02}},
    {"route": "/api/embeddings", "head_sample": 0.1, "tail_base": 0.005}
  ],
  "adaptive": {"cost_signal": "ingest_tokens", "max_ingest_per_minute": 500000}
}
```
jess: notes: head_sample is for the first N spans/important events; tail_base is baseline probability for additional spans.
priya: ops concerns: how do you test this without nuking visibility? Need canary by route and a revert hook. Also audit logs and rollout windows.
zach: important: sampling must preserve trace connectivity. deterministically sample by trace_id modulo N so child spans still attach. Also export sampled flags and unsampled counts as metrics.
mike: exporter tradeoffs: kafka gives buffer + backpressure handling but adds infra. direct honeycomb/observability vendor exporter is simpler but we hit spikes. Maybe hybrid: kafka for heavy tenants.
nana: UX request: console should show "expected retention" + "estimated cost delta" per-route before applying. also a dry-run mode that shows what would be sampled.
jess: example dry-run API call:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/telemetry/policies -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/api/generate","tail_base":0.02,"dry_run":true}'
```
priya: add: rollout_window param (start/end), and require a changelist + owner for >= 10% retention delta.
zach: also: ship an eval harness that measures quality delta when tail sampling changes (e.g., sampling's effect on error triage queries). we should track recall on alerting rules.
mike: on implementation: controller that watches tenant budget signal (credits used / token ingest) and adjusts tail multipliers per route. it should expose metrics and a simulated "what-if" API.
nana: ok i'll draft a design doc and a small POC controller. will include: deterministic trace sampling, per-route tier overrides, canary rollout, dry-run, console preview + audit. i'll open PR for controller and console mockups. :eyes: :shipit:
priya: pls include failure modes: controller offline -> fall back to conservative global policy.
jess: also include migration plan for historical spans/retention-backed billing. we need to keep retention metadata on span envelopes.
nana: thanks all — i'll post the design link when ready.
